definitions.explanation: representing something as greater or more important than it really is

examples.japanese: それは{誇張|こちょう}ではない。
{彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}には{誇張|こちょう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: His stories contain a lot of exaggeration.

examples.japanese: {誇張|こちょう}なしに{言|い}えば、{最高|さいこう}の{体験|たいけん}だった。
examples.english: Without exaggeration, it was the best experience.

notes:
VERB FORM:
{誇張|こちょう}する - to exaggerate

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {誇張|こちょう}なしに - without exaggeration
- {誇張|こちょう}が{過|す}ぎる - to exaggerate too much
- {誇張|こちょう}{表現|ひょうげん} - hyperbole, exaggerated expression

LITERARY TERM:
{誇張法|こちょうほう} - hyperbole (rhetorical device)

RELATED:
- {大|おお}げさ - exaggerated, dramatic
- {言|い}い{過|す}ぎ - overstatement
